title: merge-when-green configuration (.github/merge-when-green.json, read from the integration branch)
description: This file is riesgo-3 itself: a PR cannot relax its own gate, and the gate never reads it from the PR's head.

max_auto_class.description: Highest riesgo class merged without the owner. 1 and 2 need a lens verdict pinned to the head SHA (verdict_authors).

required_checks.description: Jobs that must be green on the PR's head, keyed by workflow FILE and job name.

required_push_checks.description: Jobs that must be green on a push to the integration branch: the signal of develop-health (revert-on-red).

state_workflows.description: Workflow files that re-read live PR state (labels, title, body) on every event; for them the latest run is the truth. Every other workflow: a failed run is cleared only by a re-run of that same run.

risk_paths.description: Repo-specific surfaces. They can only RAISE a class.

renovate_minor_class.description: Class of a dependency-bot PR that only bumps versions (every commit the bot's, no install hooks, no foreign registry). 3 keeps them with the owner; lowering it is the owner's decision.

app_slug.description: Slug of the merge App: its merges are the only ones develop-health reverts.

job.description: the job's name as GitHub shows it
